checks.invariant: Diagnostic output must not cross a caller-identity boundary or accept an untrusted command/endpoint selector.
checks.result: server.py238-248 applies the configured Bearer policy to /network/status, /health/tools and /health/readiness; only exact /health is exempt. Empty-token policy belongs to hypothesis A, not a new helper bypass. tailscale.py11-38 uses fixed argv tailscale status --json with five-second timeout and returns the parsed raw status; there is no caller-controlled shell argument. health_check.py80-111 and114-234 check trusted configured Ollama URL, module presence, executable/file paths and audio devices; config_check.py32-51 logs boolean/component names. system_stats.py15-79 returns utilization and visible process names/PIDs, not credentials or process command lines. No separately lower-authority diagnostic role or cross-principal exposure was established. No actual diagnostics/provider/hardware command was executed.

checks.invariant: Arithmetic and complexity helpers must not interpret chat as executable Python or caller-supplied model/runtime authority.
checks.result: direct_responder.py43-84 restricts input to an80-character arithmetic alphabet, then recursively interprets only numeric constants and whitelisted AST arithmetic/unary operators; each result is magnitude bounded. It does not call eval/exec or permit names/calls/attributes. complexity_router.py30-63 selects configured models and fixed80/150/700 response token budgets; server.py553-555 uses this decision, rather than executing a generated TaskPlan. Fractional powers of negative bases can yield complex results and a later uncaught formatting TypeError; this supports only a per-request robustness note, not code execution or shared denial of service.

checks.invariant: Planner output must remain data and failure must not create an execution authorization.
checks.result: planner.py20-61 catches unavailable/model/JSON errors and returns a single-goal fallback. Its parser validates steps/tool_hints as string lists and positive estimated_turns (82-104); it returns a TaskPlan data object and never dispatches the hints. Active server planning uses complexity_router.decide at553-555. No planner-to-tool execution or approval bypass path was found. Model output size/list counts are not independently bounded in this unused data planner, but no lower-trust-to-privileged execution effect was established.

checks.invariant: Embedding/cache influence may choose only discovered candidates and must not supply execution approval or lower the selected tool own safety gate.
checks.result: tool_embeddings.py59-90 iterates the caller candidate list, binds cached entries to configured model and current description, and returns a scored candidate name. router.py117-159 applies this only to use_tool results; failures fall back to the existing selection. registry.py153-224 then loads the actual selected tool and independently enforces its own Level3 denial, configured confirmation requirement and dry-run before module.execute. Cache/provider data lacks finite-vector/dimension/file-size limits, atomic writes or ownership validation, but local cache/provider identity is trusted in the visible deployment model and no cross-principal cache modification or gate bypass was established.

checks.invariant: Status report state readers must not activate work or derive authority from failed or stale local data.
checks.result: morning_report.py13-89 reads fixed root-relative project_state.json and tasks/state.json, catches parse/read errors, coerces counts and produces narration; it never writes/activates execution or derives an authorization. boot.py136-140 consumes the report as text. get_stats normalizes utilization/GPU temperature only. The unconditional All systems operational phrase and stale JSON-era pending count can mislead operators, but no concrete unauthorized operation or cross-principal leakage was established. No real state files or GPU/system diagnostics were read.

checks.invariant: Ancillary readiness/installer/audio tools must not accept lower-trust executable or output selectors implicitly.
checks.result: tools/cli/__init__.py19-45 only checks named executable availability or returns a dry-run plan; it does not execute its command field. install.ps1 uses the operator PATH python and fixed repository-relative scripts/install.py; no network/install was performed. wake_diag.py100-140 explicitly captures a caller-requested finite frame count, stores scalar score/detected CSV rows under scripts/, and cleans up hardware handles in finally. CLI duration, PATH and project directory are trusted operator inputs; no public route to arbitrary duration/path or separately writable output ancestor was established. Its output collision/bounds and model/hardware dependency behavior remain operational hardening, not a demonstrated boundary failure.

hardening: Minimize /network/status raw Tailscale JSON and readiness path/error detail to the operator-visible fields actually needed. In token-enabled mode these routes already require the shared credential; no separate unauthorized reader was established. Empty-token reachability remains hypothesis A.

Move synchronous configured-provider/Tailscale/audio diagnostics out of async route execution and bound captured output sizes. Current explicit provider/tailscale timeouts are two/five seconds, and ordinary work blocking alone is not reported as a shared-service DoS finding.

Validate finite numeric embedding vectors with explicit dimension/file limits and atomically write a private cache. Current cache/provider inputs are trusted in the visible model, and registry safety still gates selected tools.

Reject complex/nonfinite arithmetic intermediates and catch formatting TypeError. Source predicts a per-request failure for (-1)**0.5+1; no runtime check or stronger impact was asserted. This is a variant to account for in existing accepted-session cleanup coverage, not a separate security candidate.

Replace unconditional All systems operational narration and legacy tasks/state.json pending counts with truthful current authority/recovery status or explicit unavailable text. No authorization is based on that narration.

Ancillary wake diagnostics accumulate the explicitly requested capture in memory and publish timestamp CSV without exclusive creation. Operator invocation and protected project directory are assumptions; no other-UID write/output-control prerequisite was established.
